metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows the Standing Puppy stretch — an easy exercise that may help give quick relief from lower back arthritis pain and stiffness.

It can be done at home, requires no equipment, and may start easing discomfort in as little as 30 seconds.

Give it a try and let us know how it works for you!
